contexts.text: The seven years of plenty of provision in the land of Egypt () = the scientifics to which good from the Celestial of the Spiritual can be applied.

The years of plenty of provision = states of the multiplication of truth in the Natural... In general, by the seven years of plenty of provision, and the seven years of famine, in the land of Egypt, are described the states of man's reformation and regeneration; and, in the supreme sense, the states of the glorification of the Lord's Human. AC 5276, Explained. AC 5292. AC 5339. AC 5342.
All the plenty of provision... shall be given to oblivion () = the removal of truth, and the apparent privation thereof in both Naturals.

From this age, man is imbued with truths by instructions... and, in proportion as he is in the affection of good, truths are conjoined by the Lord with the good with him, and are stored up for use. This state is what is signified by the seven years of plenty of provision. These truths adjoined to good are what, in the proper sense, are called remains. AC 5349.
